thermal_inertia_class_from_esa_cci_lccs.assumption: This mapping is an ASSUMPTION of the build, not a measured thermal inertia. ESA CCI land cover classes describe cover type, not thermal inertia; each class is assigned to the team category whose thermal behaviour it most resembles. The cell's thermal_inertia_class is the category that holds the largest number of 300 m CCI pixels in the 1-degree cell (water pixels included, CCI 'no data' (0) excluded).

rock_or_bare_frac_classes.definition: share of the cell's land (non-water, non-no-data) CCI pixels that are bare areas (200-202) or sparse vegetation <15% cover (150-153). It is a bare-or-sparsely-vegetated fraction from a land-cover classification, NOT a rock abundance; bare_frac keeps 200-202 only.

permafrost_class_from_obu_probability.input: permafrost_area_frac = mean Obu et al. permafrost probability (PERPROB, 0-1) over the 1 km map pixels whose centre falls in the cell = expected share of the mapped exposed ground underlain by permafrost

thresholds.esporadico: 0.01 - 0.50 (IPA sporadic 0.10-0.50 merged with isolated patches 0.01-0.10, because the team has no 'isolated' category)

permafrost_class_from_obu_probability.reason: IPA / Brown et al. (1997) zone definitions by areal extent (continuous 90-100 %, discontinuous 50-90 %, sporadic 10-50 %, isolated 0-10 %), as used by Obu et al. (2019) for their zonation
permafrost_class_from_obu_probability.missing: empty where the maps have no valid pixel: south of about 18-25 N outside Antarctica (mountain permafrost of the Andes, East Africa, etc. is NOT mapped), Greenland and other ice sheets/glaciers, and the Antarctic ice sheet (only ice-free rock outcrops are mapped); also empty on cells with no CCI land pixel
permafrost_class_from_obu_probability.level_note: Obu et al. permafrost probability is a model output (CryoGrid equilibrium run); the zone thresholds are assumed from IPA/Brown et al. definitions. Relabelled from DERIVED during verification.
